links.outcome: Ambient scribe note quality (PDQI-9), including accuracy, hallucination and bias, in simulated inpatient encounters
links.effect: Generated notes scored 46.91/50 (SD 1.35); high scores for accuracy, thoroughness, internal consistency; free from hallucination and bias; organization/usefulness 4/5 (0.5) because notes needed editing to fit surgical style.
links.quote: On average (SD), the generated notes scored 46.91/50 (1.35).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of an ambient clinical scribe (DAX Copilot) using simulated inpatient scenarios and evaluated by authors using a standardized scoring tool (PDQI-9), but it does not compare outcomes with vs. without a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
